title.en: MALACANAN'k " BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES RECONSTITUTING THE DISPOSAL COMMITTEE CREATED UNDER E.O. NO. 285 WHEREAS, Executive Order No. 285 was issued on July 25, 1987 creating the Disposal Committee in the national level to be composed of representative of th.e owning agency as Chairman, representatives of the Commission on Audit (COA) and Department Budget and Management (DBM) as members, and also creating the Regional Disposal Committees to be composed of the representatives the regional owning agency as Chairman, and the representatives of the COA Regional Office and DBM Regional Office as Members; unserviceable equipment and property of the govemment to avoid further deterioration, especially those exposed to the elements; .'. WHEREAS, COA has withdrawn from being a Member of such Committees due to the lifting of all pre-audit activities mandated by Section 2 (2), Article IX-D of the Constitution doing, there is now an urgent need to reconstitute the members thereof; WHEREAS, pursuant to the provisions of Section 10 of the General Provisions of RA. No. 8174, the disposal of unserviceable, and/ or excess equipment, supplies and materials is the responsibility the respective owning department/ agency; NOW, THEREFORE, FIDEL V. RAMOS, Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by the Constitution, hereby order and ordain the reconstitution of the Disposal Committee
